title: oxychloe haumaniana

It is a medicinal plant native to the tropical regions of South America. The plant is used for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Oxychloe haumaniana include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including vasodilation, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammatory effects.
